mapper.sql: r.*, u.nickname AS from_user_name, u.avatar AS from_user_avatar, g.title AS goods_title, g.images AS goods_image
FROM review r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.from_user_id LEFT JOIN goods g ON g.id = r.goods_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (order_id, order_no, goods_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, role, item1_score, item2_score, item3_score, overall_score, content, images, auto_default) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{goodsId}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{role}, #{item1Score}, #{item2Score}, #{item3Score}, #{overallScore}, #{content}, #{images}, #{autoDefault})
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE r.goods_id = #{goodsId} AND r.role = 0 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT
WHERE r.to_user_id = #{sellerId} AND r.role = 0 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.goods_id AS goodsId, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, o.seller_id AS sellerId, o.complete_time AS completeTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE order_id = o.id AND role = 0) AS buyerReviewed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE order_id = o.id AND role = 1) AS sellerReviewed FROM `order` o WHERE o.status = 3 AND o.complete_time IS NOT NULL AND o.complete_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 DAY) HAVING buyerReviewed = 0 OR sellerReviewed = 0
